part_functions.name: force_transmitting_link
part_functions.function: Transmits tensile, compressive, or limited pivoting loads between a clevis-pin connection at the rear and an open hook interface at the front.

part_functions.name: detachable_end_connection
part_functions.function: Provides two different detachable interfaces: a captured transverse pin joint at the clevis end and an open engagement hook at the opposite end.

sections.name: Rear forked clevis at the negative-X end

section_functions.name: pin_joint_interface
section_functions.function: Two laterally separated rounded lugs surround a central slot and support a coaxial transverse pin, allowing an inserted mating member to pivot about the Y-axis.

section_functions.name: clevis_load_transfer
section_functions.function: The paired lugs divide pin reaction loads symmetrically across the central slot and transfer them into the tapered spine.

features.name: Central clevis slot and slot termination

feature_functions.name: receive_mating_tab
feature_functions.function: The opposed planar walls create a central Y-direction gap for a mating eye or tab; the negative-X-facing termination face closes the slot toward the body and supports both fork arms.

feature_functions.name: structural_relationship
feature_functions.function: The two slot walls are symmetric about the XZ mid-plane and are joined by the slot termination face; both are adjacent to the pin bores and rear lug geometry.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Negative-Y clevis inner wall at y=-3.5 mm, including the boundary of the transverse pin opening.
Planar slot termination at x=-60.75 mm connecting the two fork arms to the main spine.
Positive-Y clevis inner wall at y=3.5 mm, symmetric to face 3 and bordering the transverse pin opening.

features.name: Coaxial pin bores through the two clevis lugs

feature_functions.name: locate_and_support_pin
feature_functions.function: The two radius-3 mm cylindrical bore segments are coaxial along Y and support a nominal 6 mm transverse pin across the clevis slot.

feature_functions.name: permit_pivoting
feature_functions.function: The cylindrical interface permits rotation of the connected member or pin while retaining it transversely through both fork arms.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Radius-3 mm bore surface through the negative-Y clevis lug, coaxial with the bore in the opposite lug.
Radius-3 mm bore surface through the positive-Y clevis lug, coaxial with face 1 along the Y-axis.

features.name: Rounded outer ends of the clevis lugs

feature_functions.name: distribute_pin_load
feature_functions.function: The radius-7.5 mm outer lug profiles provide material around the pin bore and reduce stress concentration at the rear end.

feature_functions.name: symmetric_fork_support
feature_functions.function: The two disconnected cylindrical surface groups are symmetric across y=0 and structurally support the corresponding coaxial bore segments.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Radius-7.5 mm rounded exterior of the negative-Y clevis lug.
Radius-7.5 mm rounded exterior of the positive-Y clevis lug, symmetric to face 6.

sections.name: Long tapered load-carrying spine through the central X region

section_functions.name: connect_end_interfaces
section_functions.function: Forms the continuous structural connection between the rear clevis and front hook while maintaining a solid load path.

section_functions.name: efficient_load_transfer
section_functions.function: The broad, gradually tapered rectangular section places more material near the larger clevis end and reduces section size toward the hook, resisting axial load and bending with reduced mass.

feature_functions.name: carry_axial_and_bending_load
feature_functions.function: The top, positive-Y side, bottom, and negative-Y side planes form an adjacent closed surface loop around the main spine and carry loads between both end fittings.

feature_functions.name: integrate_end_sections
feature_functions.function: These continuous planar surfaces blend directly into the clevis and hook regions, structurally supporting both interfaces without a separate fastened joint.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Upper inclined plane of the tapered spine, rising slightly toward the negative-X clevis end.
Positive-Y tapered side plane extending between the clevis region and the front hook.
Lower inclined plane of the tapered spine, forming the bottom load-carrying surface.
Negative-Y tapered side plane extending between the clevis region and the front hook.

sections.name: Open hook and retaining nose at the positive-X end

section_functions.name: open_member_engagement
section_functions.function: The curved hook root and concave throat allow a pin, rod, cable end, or similar transverse member to enter laterally and seat in the hook without dismantling the rear clevis joint.

section_functions.name: retain_engaged_member
section_functions.function: The upstanding terminal nose partially closes the hook opening and opposes accidental withdrawal while the larger outer hook curvature transfers load into the tapered spine.

features.name: Curved hook root and concave throat

feature_functions.name: seat_transverse_member
feature_functions.function: The radius-3 mm inner curved surfaces define the hook throat, while the radius-9 mm outer curvature provides the surrounding load-bearing hook body.

feature_functions.name: transfer_hook_load
feature_functions.function: The outer hook curve supports and reinforces the inner throat and transfers contact force smoothly into the adjacent tapered spine.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Primary radius-3 mm concave throat surface at the transition from the tapered spine into the hook.
Secondary radius-3 mm curved throat transition leading upward toward the terminal retaining nose.
Radius-9 mm convex outer hook surface forming the lower load-bearing body of the hook.

feature_functions.name: oppose_disengagement
feature_functions.function: The upstanding end projection forms the outer lip of the hook and obstructs direct withdrawal of a seated transverse member.

feature_functions.name: structural_relationship
feature_functions.function: The nose is adjacent to the hook throat, capped at z=15 mm, and approximately symmetric about y=0; its cylindrical exterior blends into the hook body.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Narrow negative-Y side transition of the retaining nose at y=-3 mm.
Radius-3 mm vertical-axis semicylindrical exterior of the terminal retaining nose.
Narrow positive-Y side transition of the retaining nose at y=3 mm, symmetric to face 12.
Horizontal top cap of the hook tip and retaining nose at z=15 mm.
